== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added three facts from [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216041033/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/2005worlds.htm The Road to Worlds 2005], [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216042725/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Prize_Structure_2004.htm Prizes, Prizes, and More Prizes!] (both 2004) and [https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=7 10 Questions with Scott Lingrell] (8 October 2008). The 2004 and 2008 pages spell the name "Nick Kolnick".
=== Missing data ===
* Lingrell credits "Evan and Nick Kolnick" with improving the forums; Evan's surname is not given, so Evan is unlinked.
* A gap list said [[Garrett Larson]] credited Kolnik with growing the Bespin region in the same 2008 news; the captured id=7 page (the Lingrell interview) does not say that, so it was left out.

== Old PC forum facts added (wave 2), 24 November 2026 ==
Added a 2005–2006 paragraph and two Service rows (2006 Minnesota State Championship Weekend TD; 2005 North Dakota State Championship tentative TD) from forum posts of April 2005 – June 2006 (sources in the refs).
=== Left out ===
* That users e-mailed him for activation and that banned users had re-registered (forum post 83965 says only that most zero-post accounts predate the end of automatic activation).
* That Scott Lingrell reposted the saved collecting-thread pages (forum post 112352 says only "I'll send 'em your way").
* That he posted the advocate roster on 25 April 2005 (forum post 71928 does not contain it).
* TD user-group and Championship Circuit application remarks of June 2006 (forum post 140139): the capture is a "view=next" page, so its real topic title is unknown; the co-recipient claim is not in the post.
* Twin Cities non-tournament players / one retail location (not in the 5 April 2004 post, as wave 1 found).
=== Build notes ===
* forum post 135803 was captured as the topic after "Columbus, OH Local" (view=next); the ref uses the post's own heading, "2006 Minnesota SWCCG State Championship Weekend", as on [[2006 Minnesota State Championship]]. E-mail addresses in the announcement are left out.
